probe_detail.name: Proportion of sentences written in the passive voice
Gives a mechanism for why the proposed approach should work
Distinguishes what is new here from what was already known
Extent of British rather than American spelling

final.name: Theory-to-Algorithm Closure
final.audit_justification: Connecting assumptions and theoretical claims to the implemented algorithm is genuine evidence of methodological coherence.

final.name: Boundary-condition characterization
final.audit_justification: Stating operating conditions, limitations, and failure regimes demonstrates substantive understanding and calibrated claims.

final.name: Novel Problem Formulation Together with Infrastructure
final.audit_justification: A genuinely novel problem formulation supported by usable datasets or simulators is a substantive research contribution, despite the criterion's strong preference against standard tasks.

final.name: Claim auditability
final.audit_justification: Specific and auditable claims are direct evidence of rigor, scope control, and reproducibility.

final.name: Mathematical Notation Density
final.audit_justification: Raw notation density primarily identifies formatting and research genre without assessing whether the mathematics is sound or useful.

final.name: Broad Applicability Together with Minimal Architectural Overhead
final.audit_justification: Applicability across base models and low architectural or inference overhead are substantive properties of a method's utility.

final.name: Branded System or Acronym Prominence
final.audit_justification: Acronym and brand prominence reflects presentation and naming practices rather than research merit.

final.name: Code/repo release boilerplate mention
final.audit_justification: The boilerplate or link is presentation furniture, although its upstream cause—an actual code release—can also improve reproducibility.
final.upstream_parent: author's/lab's practice of publishing code; institutional resourcing and reputation

final.name: Raw formatting and LaTeX residue
final.audit_justification: LaTeX residue and copy-paste artifacts reflect document processing rather than the underlying research.

final.name: Lexical Economy Together with High Conceptual Density
final.audit_justification: Expressing substantial ideas precisely without unnecessary jargon is genuine evidence of conceptual clarity and writing craft.

final.name: Principled cross-regime generalization
final.audit_justification: Mechanistically justified generalization across regimes is stronger research evidence than an unprincipled collection of applications.

final.name: Insider citation-and-lineage naming inside the abstract
final.audit_justification: The amount of citation naming is partly a venue and prose convention, though deep familiarity with the literature can also contribute to better research.
final.upstream_parent: author's embeddedness in the subfield / seniority and network position

final.name: Encoding of Structural Inductive Biases
final.audit_justification: Correctly encoding known structural constraints rather than ignoring them can constitute meaningful model design and domain reasoning.

final.name: Abstract length and clause elaboration
final.audit_justification: Length and clause elaboration are verbosity and syntax measures that do not assess whether the added content is valuable.

final.name: Cross-level interface coherence
final.audit_justification: Coherent interfaces between representations and observable inputs or outputs are substantive evidence that a multi-stage method is well specified.

final.name: Framed-as-response-to-recent-work positioning
final.audit_justification: Corrective framing is a rhetorical and temporal positioning marker, although informed engagement with recent limitations can arise from genuine command of the field.
final.upstream_parent: position in the run of submissions on this sub-topic — how late-arriving/derivative the work is relative to when the topic became active, i.e. whether the authors had already seen the 'obvious' first takes

final.name: Causal Isolation of Contributions
final.audit_justification: Controlled comparisons and ablations provide genuine evidence about which components cause observed improvements.

final.name: Superlative/marketing adjective density
final.audit_justification: Counting promotional adjectives without checking their truth measures rhetorical style rather than research quality.

final.name: Tradeoff Articulation
final.audit_justification: Identifying competing objectives and explaining how their tradeoff is controlled demonstrates substantive problem and method understanding.

final.name: Late-arriver framing: repairs a crowded, already-named literature
final.audit_justification: Late-arriver framing primarily identifies a mature topic and a conventional positioning style rather than the merit of the proposed correction.
final.upstream_parent: position of the submission in the stream of entries on that topic (how crowded the subarea already is at submission time, and how late this entry lands in it)

final.name: Conceptual unification
final.audit_justification: Deriving meaningful relationships among previously separate methods or objectives is a substantive conceptual contribution.

final.name: Baseline difficulty is calibrated and honestly low
final.audit_justification: Reporting weak baselines, remaining headroom, and imperfect results provides honest calibration and evidence about problem difficulty.

final.name: Paradigm-Shifting Challenge to Dogma
final.audit_justification: Successfully overturning a widely held assumption with supporting proof is genuine evidence of novelty and importance.

final.name: Density of exact quantitative claims
final.audit_justification: The sheer count of numerical figures is a surface feature, although extensive quantitative evaluation and precise reporting can also accompany stronger empirical work.
final.upstream_parent: author's emphasis on reporting empirical gains

final.name: Root-cause diagnosis vs. symptom patching
final.audit_justification: Diagnosing and addressing an underlying failure mechanism is substantively stronger evidence than an unexplained symptom-level heuristic.
